where.if: AND (u.name ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR u.login_id ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR u.phone ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: ORDER BY p.parent_id DESC LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parents p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id
